purpose: Shared-account capital/frequency analysis, declared before portfolio outcomes; retrospective extension of inspected signals.
notes: Same causal signals, 2R targets, fees, slippage, market calendars and one-signal-per-session/two-trades-per-asset-day rules as the breadth study. No performance-based priority or new filter search.
One idealized USD equity pool. Cash plus marked open P&L drives every new size. No summing independent account returns or scaling their trades.

At each minute all observed symbols are marked to their opens, existing open-price exits are processed, then new entries are allocated alphabetically before any intraminute path is traversed. Later minute extremes never finance an earlier entry.

Reserve full published initial margin per futures contract throughout the day, not low intraday margins. This static planning proxy is not reconstructed historical broker margin, a broker quote or proof that execution is permitted.

Reserve 100% gross marked notional for stocks (including hypothetical shorts) and long-only BTC spot. Keep at least 20% equity unallocated on entry. Stock borrow availability/charges and actual broker buying power are not reconstructed.

At most two concurrent positions and one equity-index future. Size for at most 1% planned equity risk per entry, 2% combined planned open risk and remaining 3% opening-equity daily loss budget. Fees/slippage and whole quantities included. Gaps can exceed planned risk.

Daily-loss or capital-deficit halts are checked at common minute marks; liquidation occurs at each position's next observed open with adverse slippage. Drawdown is measured on minute open/close marks, not tick extrema.

Roll gaps close at the last available old-contract mark, with slippage, booked when the new contract is observed (never backdated in the shared ledger). Such exits are tagged unverified research marks.

Daily return uses consecutive shared-account day-end marks on dates with any included futures observations. Zero-trade dates count. Monthly returns compound; arithmetic daily return and geometric daily equivalent are reported separately.
The screened-five basket is selected from the already inspected year and includes MGC 10m. It is a hindsight-selected illustration, not evidence that filtering generalizes or an all-5m portfolio.

One virtual pool cannot establish actual transferable buying power across futures, stock and crypto brokers. Capital is simulated trading equity, excluding living expenses, taxes, platform/data subscriptions and broker-specific account restrictions. No live changes or orders.
